title: Contents Packout & Storage Second Reset Crew for Large Households
content:
Large households take a second reset crew at the Contents Packout & Storage furniture reset. **When the furniture item quantities on the job's packout lines total at least the second-crew hourly threshold, the second crew is charged as technician time, the furniture items times the second-crew hours per piece times the tier's contents technician hourly rate; when they total at least the mid second-crew threshold but fewer than the hourly threshold, the second crew is charged per piece, the furniture items times the mid second-crew charge; with fewer furniture items than the mid threshold, no second crew is charged.**

## Crew schedule

| Furniture items on the job's packout lines | Second crew |
|---|---|
| 40 or more (at least the second-crew hourly threshold) | technician time: items times 0.2 hours per piece times the tier's contents technician hourly rate |
| 25 to 39 (at least the mid threshold, fewer than 40) | per piece: items times 3.25 |
| fewer than 25 | none |

The hourly rate is the tier figure on the product's schedule of labor charges.

## Cases (hypothetical hourly rate of 40.00, not a tier figure)

- 24 items: no second crew.
- 25 items: 25 times 3.25, or 81.25.
- 39 items: 126.75.
- 40 items: 40 times 0.2 is 8 hours, times 40.00, or 320.00.
